 Post published at 18:29 BST 18:29 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Nice play by Sunderland again but Nordi Mukiele tries an effort from a tight angle and it goes wide.
 Again, as has been the case on a few occasions, there may have been a better option in the box. 
 43 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:28 BST 18:28 BST 
 Jablonec 0-0 Brighton 
 Jablonec have had a couple of moments but are largely defending deep and Brighton are finding it tough to find a way through them.
 Image source, Reuters 
 13 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Danso has a mistake in him published at 18:27 BST 18:27 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Gary Bennett 
Ex-Sunderland defender on BBC Radio Newcastle 
 That’s what we’re saying about Danso, there’s a mistake in him. 
 He’s miskicked the ball, he’s committed the foul and ended up with a yellow card. 
 37 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 18:26 BST 18:26 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Kevin Danso, who was sent off in the Premier League at Bournemouth on Sunday, picks up the first yellow card of the game.
 He miscontrols the ball and then has to bring down Lech Poznan captain Mikael Ishak. 
 9 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:26 BST 18:26 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 The hosts haven't had a shot for more than 25 minutes now.
 Sunderland have weathered the response to their early opener well. 
 41 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:24 BST 18:24 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 Prioritise Europe! Regardless of what happens between now and May, Sunderland will be relegated at some point in the next 10 years, it's a near certainty. But they may not be back in Europe for another 50.
 Richard 
 95 159 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:23 BST 18:23 BST 
 Jablonec 0-0 Brighton 
 Ambitious from Olivier Boscagli. He has a decent amount of space in front of him around 35 yards from goal and he decides to go for the shot, but the ball was rising the moment it left his boot.
 14 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:22 BST 18:22 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 It has got a little scrappy in the past few minutes. 
 Not much to report. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 30 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:20 BST 18:20 BST 
 Jablonec 0-0 Brighton 
 Adam Virgo 
Former Brighton captain on TNT Sports 
 There was a small period in the first half where the game just got a little bit scrappy and Jablonec had one or two moments of joy but now Brighton are just turning up the quality again. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 48 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:20 BST 18:20 BST 
 Jablonec 0-0 Brighton 
 Georginio Rutter shows good strength to hold off a couple of defenders before turning and flashing a shot across the face of goal.
 28 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Salah strikes against Hearts published at 18:19 BST 18:19 BST 
 Trabzonspor 1-0 Hearts 
 Hearts have fallen behind at Trabzonspor after Franculino was fouled inside the box and ex-Liverpool man Mo Salah stepped up to convert the penalty.
 You can follow dedicated coverage of this game here. 
 34 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Fofana and Angulo can 'get at' full-backs published at 18:16 BST 18:16 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Don Hutchison 
Former Sunderland midfielder on TNT Sport 
 Because Lech Poznan have so many bodies forward, it feels like if Sunderland can get it out to Fofana and Angulo, those are the players that can get at the full-backs, one v one, and take them on.
 54 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 18:16 BST 18:16 BST 
 Jablonec 0-0 Brighton 
 Really good chance for the hosts!
 Jaouen Hadjam takes no risks with a cross driven in at pace so heads it behind and Jablonec have a corner. 
 Antonín Rusek rises to meet the delivery from the set piece but sends his header just wide.
 8 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:16 BST 18:16 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Sunderland are top of the Europa League table as it stands as Juventus have been pegged back by Rennes. 
 61 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:15 BST 18:15 BST 
 Lech Poznan 0-1 Sunderland 
 Sunderland have been impressive here.
 They've had 13 shots, with eight on target, in the opening 30 minutes. 
 Poznan have had six attempts too. 
 68 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:13 BST 18:13 BST

 I'd love to see Sunderland do well in all cup competitions but the Premier League has to be prioritised.
 Paul 
 Image source, Getty Images
